## When to use it

- **Use it when:** An empty list, a search with no results, or a first visit with no items yet.
- **Not when:** Still loading (skeleton or spinner), or a load that failed (alert).

Instead:

- [Skeleton](./skeleton.md): Still loading.
- [Alert](./alert.md): Something went wrong.

## How Content first uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">An empty state</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> An invitation, not a dead end</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> &quot;No items&quot;</div></div><div class="cap">An empty list is a chance to show what the product offers. Example: “Nothing saved yet. Tap Save on any article to read it later.”</div></div></div>

## Words

- Write to one person: "you", not "users".
- Short sentences with room to breathe.
- Explain why before asking for anything.
- Use: Read, Save for later, You, Next issue. Avoid: Click here, Submit, Users, Content.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Browse guides

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add empty
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

From shadcn/ui. It reads shadcn's variables, which theme.css maps onto this system's semantic tokens, and the radius, shadow and text scale in shadcn.css.
